purpose: Test whether the Muon-family validation advantage shrinks or reverses as a fixed query is scored against progressively more candidates from the same pinned mined list.

nesting: width 7 is the canonical validation row's seven negatives in their stored order
width 10 appends the three unselected documents from the reconstructed first-ten eligible pool in mined order
larger widths append unique documents in the pinned mined-score order, excluding the positive and already selected documents

evaluation.baseline_check: width-7 sample metrics must reproduce the existing validation evaluator on the selected 224 rows within 1e-5 absolute tolerance

analysis.primary_readout: within-optimizer Spearman correlation between candidate-set metric and final 14-task BEIR as a function of width
analysis.secondary_readout: high-dose minus retrieval-optimal paired query contrast as a function of width
analysis.prediction: Muon and NorMuon prefer 3e-3 at width 7, but that advantage shrinks or reverses toward the 3e-4 full-corpus ordering as width increases; AdamW ordering changes less

primary_support_rule.baseline_reproduction: all 12 width-7 evaluations pass the 1e-5 sample-level check
primary_support_rule.width_7_ordering: for both Muon and NorMuon, 3e-3 minus 3e-4 has lower mean loss and higher mean margin
primary_support_rule.width_2048_reversal: for both Muon and NorMuon, 3e-3 minus 3e-4 has higher mean loss and lower mean margin
primary_support_rule.decision: all three conditions are required to support missing-candidate coverage as the explanation

analysis.partial_evidence_rule: If the width-2048 contrasts move at least halfway from their width-7 values toward zero for both challengers and both metrics but do not reverse, report attenuation without claiming mechanism support.
analysis.falsification: The missing-candidate explanation is not supported if Muon-family ordering remains equally anti-calibrated through width 2048 or if any width-7 reproduction check fails.

claim_boundary: This diagnostic was designed after the shortlist-corpus gap was observed. It is post hoc mechanism evidence and cannot replace the frozen three-seed full-corpus optimizer comparison. Mined candidates have one designated positive; unjudged relevance among other candidates is a limitation.
